---
title: "Analyzing US Census Data"
author: "Genesis"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
edu_state <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c(
    "B15003_001",
    "B15003_022",
    "B15003_023",
    "B15003_024",
    "B15003_025"
  ),
  summary_var = "B15003_001",
  year = 2020
)
```

```{r}
edu_state |>
  group_by(GEOID, NAME) |>
  summarize(
    total_adults = first(summary_est),
    bachelor_higher = sum(estimate[variable %in% c(
      "B15003_022",
      "B15003_023",
      "B15003_024",
      "B15003_025"
    )]),
    percent_bachelor_higher = 100 * bachelor_higher / total_adults,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = percent_bachelor_higher,
    y = reorder(NAME, percent_bachelor_higher)
  )) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Bachelor's Degree or Higher by State",
    x = "Adults with a bachelor's degree or higher",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 American Community Survey (ACS) 5-year estimates, table B15003."
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false
age_ca <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = c(
    median_age = "B01002_001",
    population = "B01003_001"
  ),
  state = "CA",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
age_ca_wide <- age_ca |>
  select(GEOID, NAME, variable, estimate) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = estimate)

largest_counties <- age_ca_wide |>
  slice_max(population, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  arrange(desc(population)) |>
  mutate(label_y = c(39, 35.5, 41, 33.5, 31.5))

age_ca_wide |>
  ggplot(aes(x = population, y = median_age)) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_segment(
    data = largest_counties,
    aes(xend = population, yend = label_y),
    color = "grey50"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = largest_counties,
    aes(
      y = label_y,
      label = str_remove(NAME, " County, California")
    ),
    hjust = 0,
    nudge_x = 0.05
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(
    labels = scales::label_comma(),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.5))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Age by County Population in California",
    x = "County population (log scale)",
    y = "Median age (years)",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 American Community Survey (ACS) 5-year estimates, tables B01002 and B01003."
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  state = "TX",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
income_tx |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name = "Median household income (USD)",
    labels = scales::label_dollar()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Household Income by County in Texas",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 American Community Survey (ACS) 5-year estimates."
  ) +
  coord_sf(datum = NA) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)
  )
```
